units.source_text: 髭黑大将要去向式部卿亲王诉恨，先赴自己邸内一转。

en.t: General Higekuro was going to complain of his grievances to Prince Shikibukyo, but first he stopped by his own residence.

units.source_text: 木工君出来接他，将昨夜之事一一告知。

en.t: Moku no Kimi came out to meet him and told him everything that had happened the night before.

units.source_text: 他听到女公子临去时情状，虽然一向雄赳赳地不动感情，

en.t: When he heard how the young lady had looked as she left, though he was usually a vigorous man who did not show emotion,

units.source_text: 也禁不住簌簌地流下泪来，那样子甚是可怜。

en.t: he could not hold back his tears, which fell in streams, and his appearance was deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 他说：“哎呀！

en.t: He said, “Ah!

units.source_text: 此人异乎寻常，狂病时时发作，

en.t: This woman is unlike ordinary people, and fits of madness come over her from time to time.

units.source_text: 我多年来百般忍耐原谅，这点苦心他们完全不解，奈何！

en.t: For many years I have endured and forgiven her in every possible way, but they do not understand my painful efforts at all. What can I do?

units.source_text: 倘是专横自大之人，决不能与她相处到今天。

en.t: If I were a domineering and arrogant man, I could never have lived with her until today.

units.source_text: 算了吧，她本人反正是个废人，

en.t: Well, let it be. She herself is, after all, a ruined person,

units.source_text: 任凭住在何处，都是一样。

en.t: and wherever she lives, it will be the same.

units.source_text: 但这几个孩子，不知亲王怎样抚养他们。”

en.t: But as for these children, I do not know how the Prince will bring them up.”

units.source_text: 他一面叹息，一面看看塞在真木柱里的那首诗，

en.t: As he sighed, he looked at the poem that had been tucked into the maki pillar,

units.source_text: 觉得笔迹虽然幼稚，心情甚是可怜，使他恋恋不舍。

en.t: and though the handwriting was childish, the feeling in it seemed so pitiful that he could not tear himself away.

units.source_text: 他一路上揩着眼泪，来到了式部卿亲王邸内，

en.t: Wiping his tears all along the way, he arrived at Prince Shikibukyo’s residence,

units.source_text: 然而无人出来与他相见。

en.t: but no one came out to meet him.

units.source_text: 亲王对女儿说道：“你何必去见他呢！

en.t: The Prince said to his daughter, “Why should you go to see him?

units.source_text: 此人一向阿谀权势，不是今次开始变心的。

en.t: That man has always courted power; this is not the first time his heart has changed.

units.source_text: 他见新弃旧，已有多年，我早就闻知。

en.t: He has been taking up the new and casting off the old for years, and I heard of it long ago.

units.source_text: 你要等他回心转意，万无希望。

en.t: If you wait for him to change his mind and return to you, there is no hope at all.

units.source_text: 若再对他留恋，你的毛病势必越来越重。”

en.t: If you still cling to him, your illness will certainly grow worse and worse.”

units.source_text: 如此劝阻，亦自有理。

en.t: There was a certain reason in the way he advised and restrained her.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将叫侍女向亲王传言：“此事未免太急躁了。

en.t: General Higekuro had a lady-in-waiting convey this message to the Prince: “This matter has been handled far too hastily.

units.source_text: 我已和她生下一群可爱的子女，以为彼此都可信赖，

en.t: I have had a number of dear children with her, and I believed that we could trust one another,

units.source_text: 不必常诉衷情，此种疏慢之罪，再也无法辩解了。

en.t: so I thought there was no need to speak my heart constantly; for this neglect, I can no longer offer any excuse.

units.source_text: 但今次务请曲予原谅。

en.t: But this time, I beg you to make an exception and forgive me.

units.source_text: 日后倘世人判定我罪无可逭，即请如此处分可也。”

en.t: If in the future the world judges my guilt inescapable, then you may deal with me accordingly.”

units.source_text: 如此求情，终不见谅。

en.t: Though he pleaded in this way, in the end he was not forgiven.

units.source_text: 他便要求，至少欲见女公子一面。

en.t: He then asked at least to see the young lady once.

units.source_text: 但女公子也不出见，只来了两个男孩。

en.t: But the young lady would not come out either; only the two boys came.

units.source_text: 长男今年十岁，是殿上童，相貌甚美。

en.t: The elder son was ten years old that year and served as a palace page; his face was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 姿态虽不十分秀丽，但人人赞他非常聪明，已渐知情达理。

en.t: Although his bearing was not especially graceful, everyone praised him as very clever, and he was gradually coming to understand things sensibly.

units.source_text: 次男八岁，非常可爱，相貌很像姐姐。

en.t: The younger son was eight, extremely lovable, and looked very much like his elder sister.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将抚摸他的头发，对他说道：“我就把你当作你姐姐的替身吧。”

en.t: General Higekuro stroked his hair and said to him, “I will think of you as a substitute for your sister.”

units.source_text: 哭泣着和他们说话。

en.t: He spoke with them while weeping.

units.source_text: 他又要求，欲拜见亲王一面。

en.t: He again made a request, saying that he wished to pay his respects to the Prince in person.

units.source_text: 亲王也挡驾，说“偶感风寒，正在卧床将息”。

en.t: The Prince also refused to receive him, saying that he had caught a slight cold and was lying in bed to recover.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将觉得无聊，只得告辞而出。

en.t: General Higekuro felt empty and helpless, and had no choice but to take his leave and depart.
